note: Eight readiness checks. Plain-language descriptions; the logic is in lib/student/checklist.ts.

label.en: Every power device (like an oxygen machine) has a backup power plan
label.es: Cada aparato médico eléctrico tiene un plan de energía de respaldo

rules.check: For each person with powerDevices, powerBackupPlan is not empty

label.en: Everyone with an allergy has written emergency steps
label.es: Cada persona con alergia tiene pasos de emergencia por escrito

rules.check: For each person with allergies, allergySteps is not empty

label.es: Al menos 2 contactos de emergencia guardados

label.en: At least one out-of-town contact for regional disasters
label.es: Al menos un contacto fuera de la ciudad para desastres regionales

rules.check: At least one contact has outOfTown === true

label.en: Home address is saved for 911 dispatch
label.es: La dirección de la casa está guardada para los despachadores del 911

label.en: Emergency water stored (1 gallon per person per day for 3 days)
label.es: Agua de emergencia almacenada (1 galón por persona por día durante 3 días)

label.en: Family flood safety and evacuation plan is written
label.es: El plan familiar de inundación y evacuación está redactado

rules.check: floodPlan is not null and has text

label.en: At least one nearby low-water crossing saved (or marked 'none near us')
label.es: Al menos un cruce de agua cercano guardado (o marcado 'no hay cruces')
